devProtocol.writeGuardModeComment: pre-write-guard.js write-before-read enforcement. 'block' (default) = strict DEV protocol: existing files must be Read before Write/Edit (regression-safe, mirrors prior behavior). 'advisory' = warn-only (approve) — friendlier for non-developer/vibe-coding users at the cost of the strict read-before-write guarantee. Env override: ARTIBOT_WRITE_GUARD_MODE.

fable.comment: ON — 2-tier fleet by owner decision (2026-09-02): design + review roles run on fable, implementation/test/marketing roles stay on opus. enabled=true is the kill-switch; this allowlist (8 agents) is the ONLY set that resolves to fable. The high bucket still DECLARES model=fable for 21 agents, and that is intentional: the 12 high-bucket agents NOT in this allowlist (frontend-developer, backend-developer, tdd-guide, database-reviewer, mcp-developer, typescript-pro, refactor-cleaner, build-error-resolver, devops-engineer, performance-engineer, e2e-runner, marketing-strategist) are demoted to opus by the gate in lib/core/model-policy.js#gateFableTier — allowlist wins over bucket, by design. security-reviewer is in the high bucket, NOT in this allowlist, AND hard-pinned to opus by FABLE_DENYLIST (fable's refusal classifier false-positives on legit security work; 5.1 false-positive rate unmeasured — do not lift before measuring). Frontmatter contract: the 8 allowlisted agents/<name>.md carry model: fable, the other 20 carry model: opus — scripts/ci/validate-model-policy.js is the drift gate (gate-aware: it compares frontmatter against resolveModel, so a non-allowlisted high-bucket agent with model: opus is correct, not drift). Role aliases (deep-async) and phaseRoles below pass this gate only through resolveModel(alias|role, { agentType }) — without an agentType only enabled is consulted. Revert to single-tier opus: enabled=false + the 8 frontmatter lines back to opus. Effective cost vs Opus baseline is computed by lib/core/model-catalog.js#getCostFactor('fable') — do not duplicate the number here.

phaseRoles.comment: Team phase-role → tier map read by lib/core/model-policy.js#resolveModelForPhase (build-side roles: implementation|build|impl; review-side roles: review|inspect|crosscheck). Values are tier keys or ROLE_ALIASES from lib/core/model-catalog.js; unknown values fall back to the default (opus/opus, the pre-phaseRoles behavior). A fable side still passes the fable gate: resolveModel(agent, { role }) checks that agent against fable.allowlist/FABLE_DENYLIST, so a non-allowlisted cross-checker lands on opus; bare resolveModelForPhase(role) only checks fable.enabled.

autoApplyTriggers.comment: Tightened 2026-05-03: minComplexity high, minSubtasks/Files 3, bypass intents added. Reduces team-routing for simple Q/diagnostic requests so non-trivial multi-domain work still triggers parallel teammates. 2026-08-22: orphan key excludeTrivial ({maxLines:50,singleFile:true}) removed — it had zero consumers repo-wide; the trivial-prompt filter is hard-coded in scripts/hooks/auto-team-trigger.js#evaluatePrompt. The five functional keys that remain (logic, minSubtasks, minFiles, minComplexity, bypassIntents) are all consumed by lib/cognitive/workflow-plan.js#evaluateTrigger; this comment key is documentation only and is read by nothing.

team.comment: 2026-08-26: orphan key worktreeIsolation ({enabled,defaultMode,mergeStrategy,cleanupOnClose}) removed — it had zero JS consumers repo-wide. No handler for a /team --worktree flag ever existed, and nothing ever auto-merged a teammate worktree, so mergeStrategy/cleanupOnClose described machinery that was never built. Per-teammate isolation is a tool-level option instead: Agent(subagent_type, { isolation: 'worktree' }), documented in skills/team/SKILL.md and skills/delegation/SKILL.md. lib/core/config-schema.js validates non-strict (extra properties allowed), so a leftover worktreeIsolation key in a user's local config is ignored, not rejected. This comment key is documentation only and is read by nothing.

sub-agent.condition: Agent tool available BUT SendMessage unavailable

subAgent.condition: complexity < 0.4 AND single domain AND steps < 3

solo.trigger: single file edit, simple question, quick fix

platoon.trigger: large feature, architecture change, security audit, benchmarking

mcp.comment: MCP-driven Verification (P0-4): Artibot self-plugin MCPs allowed. External MCP/host blocked. opt-in via --mcp-verify.

runner.comment: ADR-003 Stage 2 gate: true = EXECUTE runner auto-selects dynamic-run when the classifier recommendation (options.recommendedRunner) is 'workflow'. Explicit --runner always wins. Kill-switch: set false.

fast.comment: Opt-in --fast fan-out limits. fast-profile.js clamps every value to immutable safety caps; only explicitly independent, disjoint low/medium-risk tasks receive isolated worker worktrees. Effective concurrency ceiling is 12, NOT 16: fast-profile.js#parallelCapacity takes min(hardMaxAgents, agentsPerCpu*cpuCount, maxWorktrees, taskCount), and maxWorktrees=12 is always the smaller of the two caps at these defaults, so hardMaxAgents=16 never binds. Raising hardMaxAgents alone changes nothing — raise maxWorktrees too.

supervisor.comment: S0 observe-only thresholds (vNext design §03 stuck table) read by lib/supervisor/lane-monitor.js and scripts/split/{watch,fanout-probe}.mjs. suspect < stale; a misordered pair collapses to stale. probe.* are the fanout-probe SOLO windows (main transcript active within N min AND zero subagent activity within M min). No key here triggers any action — the supervisor spine only observes.

dispatch.comment: scripts/split/dispatch.mjs: budget fills the window prompt's {BUDGET} (--budget wins); template=null uses templates/split/PROMPT-TEMPLATE.md (--template wins). The script renders prompt.md into the worktree and prints a one-line pointer; it never sends a message.

contextLifecycle.comment: vNext PR-CX01 (S0). enabled=false ships the PostCompact hook (scripts/hooks/post-compact-rehydrate.js) silent; set true to have it read the PreCompact snapshot (~/.claude/artibot-pre-compact.json), refuse it when cwd/branch differ, and report a <= maxRehydrateBytes bundle (lib/context/rehydration.js) via systemMessage + ~/.claude/artibot/post-compact/<stamp>.md. Observe-only: no automatic action, never blocks compaction. Live-verified 0 times as of 2026-09-02.

worktreeSetup.comment: scripts/split/worktree-setup.mjs: linkDirs are junction-linked from the parent checkout when absent in the worktree (win32 mklink /J, posix symlink); copyFiles are copied only when absent; installCmd (argv array, shell-free) runs only when linkDirs did not cover node_modules; envPerLane writes <worktree>/.artibot/split/<limb>/lane.env with {limb} / {limb_} substituted (e.g. E2E_DB_NAME=app_e2e_{limb_}) so parallel lanes never share an e2e database. --teardown removes reparse points only, never a real directory.

split.comment: /split (cross-session multi-worktree). maxWindows maps onto the EXISTING fast-profile keys (limits.maxWorktrees AND limits.hardMaxAgents) because normalizeFastProfile reads only four keys and silently drops unknown ones; serverEntryPaths seeds the conflict grouping so two windows never share a dev-server port; humanWaitReevalPct is the Phase 5 human-wait threshold that re-opens the headless-window (C-stage) question; recommendMinSubtasks: null = recommend=split hint OFF (opt-in). Set an integer >= 2 to enable; NOTE any value <= 6 shadows the autopilot hint (same floor). Shipped OFF because real-operator /split data is 0. These keys never touch the user settings.json cross-session inbound or peer-machine isolation settings (tests/firewall/split-config-firewall.test.js).

autopilot.comment: v4.7.2: bypass*Hooks default false (honour user pre-commit/pre-push hooks). v4.11.3: closeOnStop default false — Stop hook의 git-autopilot-close.js가 매 turn마다 commit/push를 만들어 history를 오염시키던 문제 차단. WIP interval save(git-autopilot-save.js)는 영향 없음. 이전 동작 복원: closeOnStop을 true로 토글. v4.14.0: commitStrategy 'semantic' — phase 완료 시에만 의미 커밋, stash checkpoint로 크래시 안전망 유지.

swarm._serverUrlPolicy: DATA POLICY: 기본값은 localhost(self-hosted)로 고정합니다. 외부 swarm 서버로 데이터를 보내려면 (a) 직접 self-host 하거나 (b) ARTIBOT_SWARM_SERVER 환경변수로 명시 지정 + lib/core/allowlist.json 또는 ARTIBOT_ALLOW_EGRESS로 해당 호스트를 명시 허용해야 합니다. 어떤 외부 엔드포인트도 기본값으로 출하하지 않습니다(과거 run.app 기본값은 v4.x에서 제거됨, CHANGELOG 참조).
swarm._backendPolicy: DATA POLICY: 기본 backend는 'http'(localhost self-hosted)로 고정해 출하합니다. 'git' backend는 HTTP egress guard를 우회(git 바이너리 push/pull)하므로 기본값으로 두지 않습니다. git 동기화를 쓰려면 backend를 'git'으로 명시 전환하고 gitRepoUrl에 본인 소유 private repo를 직접 지정하세요(SWARM_DEFAULTS와 일치).
swarm._gitRepoUrlWarning: DATA POLICY: git backend 활성화(enabled:true + backend:'git') 시 여기 지정한 repo로 데이터가 push됩니다. 반드시 본인/내부 소유 private repo만 지정하고, 활성화 전 개인 데이터 포함 여부를 확인하세요. 기본값 null = 미설정(외부 전송 경로 없음).

router._noveltyDefaultComment: Fallback novelty when sessionDepth is not provided. Historical hardcoded 0.3 (see audit finding #9 in .artibot/REPORTS/audit-learning-cognitive-2026-06-08.md). Tune downward (e.g. 0.15) to reduce first-query System 2 escalation; tune upward to favor deeper analysis on cold starts. Caller must forward via context.noveltyDefault — the router stays pure.

skillEvolver._comment: Classification cutoffs for createSkillEvolver. Pass these via options.thresholds when instantiating from a layer that has access to artibot.config.json. Defaults baked into lib/learning/skill-evolver.js DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS — overriding here lets ops tune without code edits. Audit ref: .artibot/REPORTS/audit-learning-cognitive-2026-06-08.md finding #4.

dream.comment: Non-destructive memory consolidation (PRD-DREAMING). Conservative defaults: feature gated OFF, dry-run default, autoAccept OFF. Input memory/*.md is NEVER modified; output lands in memory/.dream-staging/, replaced originals move to memory/.dream-archive/ (hard-delete 0). LLM Phase-2 runs only in sessions (/dreaming); nightly is Phase-1 (candidates) + wakeup marker only — zero LLM, zero MD writes (ADR-3).

nightly.comment: Allows the 05:00 hook to produce inert candidates.json + a wakeup marker. Set false to disable the nightly slot entirely.

autoAccept.comment: When enabled: insert-only, confidence >= 0.95, external-signal-backed. merge/replace always require human review. rules/CLAUDE.md are never auto-applied.

grpoRouting.comment: T4β-min (2026-06-20) + family B/C retirement (2026-06-20): the System1/2 ROUTING-BIAS family (family A) AND the candidate-eval reward/policy infra (family B/C) were RETIRED. lib/learning/grpo-optimizer.js + lib/learning/grpo/ (11 modules) + lib/cognitive/grpo-bridge.js + the nightly *-policy-trainers were deleted (theater: the GRPO reward EMITTER had no production caller, so the whole subsystem was already a no-op). REMOVED: {modelType,agentPolicy,jointPolicy} — their only readers (the deleted grpo/ policy-factory.js, agent-policy.js, joint-policy.js) are gone. PRESERVED: `skillPolicy` (read LIVE by lib/runtime/middleware/skill-trigger.js via config.learning.grpoRouting.skillPolicy) and `effortPolicy` (read LIVE by lib/cognitive/effort-policy-config.js ← effort-resolver.js). Both stay `enabled:false` (dormant identity behaviour) — kept explicit because their live out-of-scope readers still consult the config. See docs/WIRING-AUDIT-2026-05-30.md.

effort.comment: What these keys actually do (measured 2026-09-02; the plugin has NO Messages API caller and never sets output_config.effort — `grep output_config lib scripts` finds only comments). injectPrompt=true: scripts/hooks/runtime-prompt.js prepends the prose directive `[artibot:effort level=X command=Y]` (from lib/cognitive/effort-policy.js via effort-resolver.js) to the user prompt on UserPromptSubmit and persists it to runtime/current-effort.json; lib/runtime/middleware/tasks.js then copies it into task.meta.effort/taskBudget so /team can prefix each teammate. nativeApi=true: runtime-prompt.js READS the host's native effort band (lib/cognitive/native-effort.js — env var / hook stdin) and lets it override the heuristic band before persisting; it never writes the host's effort. The directive is advisory text — the model's real effort is whatever the host applies (/effort, --effort, settings). budgetMap maps each level to a recommended max_tokens for the `[artibot:task-budget]` directive (lib/runtime/task-budget.js); 'max' (200k) is the ceiling tier for the deepest agentic runs (ultracode), xhigh/high/medium/low are 1:1 with the native level names.

packs._comment: Preset packs — purpose-grouped activation presets of skills/commands that already ship inside the Artibot plugin. DATA POLICY: 100% local, no network. A pack is NOT a download bundle; it is a named list of in-plugin skill/command members a vibe-coder can verify/activate in one shot via /install --pack <name>. Members reference plugins/artibot/skills/<name>/ and plugins/artibot/commands/<name>.md. Consumed read-only by lib/core/preset-packs.js (frozen-data, never-throw). Drift guard: tests/core/preset-packs.test.js asserts every member below exists on disk.
